findings.title: Async legacy write inherits cancelled request context
findings.body: In pkg/apiserver/rest/dualwriter_mode3.go Create (and same pattern in Delete, Update, DeleteCollection) the background goroutine does context.WithTimeoutCause(ctx, ...) where ctx is the incoming request context. When the API handler returns, the request context is cancelled, which immediately cancels the derived context and aborts the async legacy write. The result is that mode 3's best-effort legacy backup frequently never happens, leaving legacy and unified storage diverged. Fix by deriving from a detached context such as context.WithoutCancel(ctx) or context.Background().

findings.title: Async legacy Create shares mutable obj causing race and stale write
findings.body: In pkg/apiserver/rest/dualwriter_mode3.go Create passes the original obj pointer to the async d.Legacy.Create goroutine while also returning it to the caller. The caller can mutate the object after return while the goroutine reads it concurrently, which is a data race. It also writes the pre-storage object instead of the created result returned by Storage, so server-assigned fields (UID, resourceVersion, defaults) are lost in legacy. Fix by DeepCopying the storage result and passing that copy to legacy.

findings.title: Create storage error recorded as legacy duration
findings.body: In pkg/apiserver/rest/dualwriter_mode3.go Create, when d.Storage.Create fails the code calls d.recordLegacyDuration(true, ...) for the storage attempt. All other error paths record storage duration for storage failures. This misattributes latency/error metrics, hiding unified-storage failures and inflating legacy metrics. Should call recordStorageDuration.

findings.title: Update storage error recorded as legacy duration
findings.body: In pkg/apiserver/rest/dualwriter_mode3.go Update, when d.Storage.Update fails the code calls d.recordLegacyDuration(true, ...) instead of d.recordStorageDuration. This corrupts the mode/kind/method metrics and makes storage failures invisible. Should mirror Delete and DeleteCollection error handling.

findings.title: Delete success metric uses object name as kind label
findings.body: In pkg/apiserver/rest/dualwriter_mode3.go Delete success path calls d.recordStorageDuration(false, mode3Str, name, ...) where the third argument is the object name. Every other call passes options.Kind as the kind label. This creates unbounded high-cardinality metric labels (one series per object name) and breaks dashboards that group by kind. Should pass options.Kind.

findings.title: DeleteCollection legacy outcome recorded as storage metric
findings.body: In pkg/apiserver/rest/dualwriter_mode3.go DeleteCollection the async legacy block calls d.recordStorageDuration(err != nil, ...) for the legacy call. The Create/Delete/Update paths correctly call recordLegacyDuration for legacy work. This misclassifies legacy latency/errors as storage, making legacy backup health unobservable. Should call recordLegacyDuration.

findings.title: Delete drops enriched logger when building context
findings.body: In pkg/apiserver/rest/dualwriter_mode3.go Delete builds log with name/kind/method but then does klog.NewContext(ctx, d.Log) instead of klog.NewContext(ctx, log). All other methods propagate the enriched logger. The consequence is Delete request logs lose name/kind/method fields, hindering debugging. Should pass log.
